posts.author: rpm
posts.community: IDFC First Bank Limited - First Bank Preference for Long Term Investors too?
posts.text: IDFC has picked up FCNR worth around 3.57billion dollars. I understand that it will provide an additional PAT of around 120 crores per quarter. In Q2 the benefit will be partial and full benefit will accrue from Q3 onwards. Let us hope that we see a better Q2, followed by better Q3 and Q4. ROA of 1+ is now assured for fy27. The concall of Q2 will provide more clarity.

posts.text: I think you made the right decision in choosing the stock and then holding onto it even after many provocations. Premature exit becomes a big regret especially when one has sat patiently for 7 years. The management has completed the structural goals. In Q1 they have shown the beginning of operational performance also. Q2 and Q3 should clear the picture further.

posts.author: rpm
posts.community: IDFC First Bank Limited - First Bank Preference for Long Term Investors too?
posts.text: Some random thoughts. Looking at current SMA of 0.77%, it is almost certain that credit cost in Q2 will not exceed 1.5%. Even if it is less, VV will keep it there by taking extra provisions. Asset growth will be 20% for certain as apart from about 5-6% domestic sequential deposit growth amounting to 16000 crores, FCNRB deposits will also add another 15000 to 20000 crores long term at 6.75% interest. this will ensure that idfc does not face any deposit problem in fy27. They can even retire some CDs, reducing cost of funds. The next capital raise would be probably through bonds of maybe around 4…
